technical_commentary: USHAMART's monthly chart is a genuine multi-year Stage-2 advance -- Rs 55 (Jul-2021) to an all-time-high close of Rs 519.80 (4-Jun-2026), ~9.4x -- with six consecutively higher monthly swing highs since Aug-2023 (349 to 366 to 382 to 422 to 465 to 506); the only real scar is a news-driven single-day gap on 11-Oct-2024 (44.6 lakh shares, 3.5x trailing volume) that preceded a genuine 32% closing drawdown into Apr-2025, before the base fully repaired and price broke the entire Oct'24-Aug'25 supply zone (~421-451) in Sep-2025 on unremarkable volume, not a fresh climax. The push to fresh highs since (May-Jun'26) is running on below-average volume (0.86x-0.36x of trailing 12-month average) with no MRPL-style buying-climax at the top, and while this name's Choppiness Index has never read 'clean' in absolute terms (never sub-45, even during the undisputed 2023 markup), the current advance (mean 53.6) is actually calmer than that 2023 leg (60.9) -- the wide monthly ranges are this stock's normal texture, not a topping signature. Docked for that persistent whipsaw character, a repeated (4x) habit of rejecting marginal new highs intra-month before resuming (most recently Nov-2025, Jun-2026), and a still-unresolved 150/200-DMA crossover (Rs 449.1 vs Rs 449.8, essentially flat) -- a monthly close below the Mar-2026 higher low (~Rs 391) would be the first real crack in an otherwise textbook advance.
